tool_schemas.name: create_document
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Word document record and initializes its persisted structure, returning the created document’s metadata (including filename and any provided title/author). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid or metadata fields are not strings, CONFLICT if a document with the same filename already exists, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create documents (or the workspace quota is exceeded). Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the document cannot be initialized.

tool_schemas.name: copy_document
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new document by copying an existing source document’s structure and metadata, returning the new document’s metadata including the resolved destination filename. Raises NOT_FOUND if source_filename does not exist, CONFLICT if destination_filename is provided and already exists, and VALIDATION_ERROR if filenames are invalid or destination resolves to the same identity as the source. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the source or create the destination (or quota is exceeded).
tool_schemas.implementation:
def copy_document(source_filename, destination_filename=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, secrets, time

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0409000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0409000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error_code=None, meta=None):
        try:
            logs = _load("request_logs.json")
            if not isinstance(logs, list):
                logs = []
            logs.append({
                "id": f"req_{secrets.token_hex(12)}",
                "endpoint": "copy_document",
                "timestamp": now,
                "status": status,
                "error_code": error_code,
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "meta": meta or {}
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
        except Exception:
            return

    def _norm_docx_full_path(p):
        if not isinstance(p, str) or not p.strip():
            return None
        s = p.strip().replace("\\", "/")
        if "\x00" in s or re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+://", s):
            return None
        s = re.sub(r"/+", "/", s)
        if s.startswith("./"):
            s = s[2:]
        s = re.sub(r"/\./", "/", s)
        if not s.lower().endswith(".docx"):
            s = s + ".docx"
        return s

    def _path_candidates(norm_full):
        if not norm_full:
            return []
        cands = [norm_full]
        if norm_full.startswith("/"):
            cands.append(norm_full.lstrip("/"))
        else:
            cands.append("/" + norm_full)
        # also try without leading server-root slash segment if present
        if norm_full.startswith("/mnt/"):
            cands.append(norm_full[1:])
        out, seen = [], set()
        for x in cands:
            if x not in seen:
                seen.add(x)
                out.append(x)
        return out

    def _find_doc(docs, norm_full):
        for c in _path_candidates(norm_full):
            for d in docs:
                if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("full_path") == c:
                    return d
        return None

    def _split_dir_filename(full_path):
        s = full_path.replace("\\", "/")
        if "/" in s:
            directory, fn = s.rsplit("/", 1)
            if directory == "":
                directory = "/"
            return directory, fn
        return ".", s

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        # mimic ULID-like prefix style but without external libs
        return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_hex(13)}"

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(source_filename, str) or not source_filename.strip():
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "source_filename must be a non-empty string")
    if destination_filename is not None and (not isinstance(destination_filename, str) or not destination_filename.strip()):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "destination_filename must be a non-empty string or null")

    src_full = _norm_docx_full_path(source_filename)
    if not src_full:
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "invalid source_filename", source_filename=source_filename)

    docs = _load("documents.json")
    if not isinstance(docs, list):
        docs = []

    src_doc = _find_doc(docs, src_full)
    if not src_doc:
        _log("error", "NOT_FOUND", {"source_full_path": src_full})
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "source document not found", source_filename=source_filename)

    # Destination resolution
    if destination_filename is None:
        # create a unique sibling copy name
        src_dir = src_doc.get("directory") or _split_dir_filename(src_doc.get("full_path", src_full))[0]
        src_fn = src_doc.get("filename") or _split_dir_filename(src_doc.get("full_path", src_full))[1]
        base = src_fn[:-5] if src_fn.lower().endswith(".docx") else src_fn
        attempt = 1
        while True:
            cand_fn = f"{base} (copy {attempt}).docx"
            dest_full = f"{src_dir.rstrip('/')}/{cand_fn}" if src_dir not in (".", "/", "") else (cand_fn if src_dir in (".", "") else f"/{cand_fn}")
            dest_full = re.sub(r"/+", "/", dest_full)
            if not _find_doc(docs, dest_full):
                break
            attempt += 1
            if attempt > 10000:
                _log("error", "CONFLICT")
                return _err("CONFLICT", "could not find an available destination filename")
    else:
        dest_full = _norm_docx_full_path(destination_filename)
        if not dest_full:
            _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "invalid destination_filename", destination_filename=destination_filename)

    # destination must not resolve to same identity as source
    if any(c in set(_path_candidates(src_doc.get("full_path") or src_full)) for c in _path_candidates(dest_full)):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "destination_filename resolves to the same document as source")

    if _find_doc(docs, dest_full):
        _log("error", "CONFLICT", {"destination_full_path": dest_full})
        return _err("CONFLICT", "destination document already exists", destination_filename=destination_filename or dest_full)

    dest_dir, dest_fn = _split_dir_filename(dest_full)

    # Load related collections
    blocks = _load("document_blocks.json")
    spans = _load("text_spans.json")
    styles = _load("styles.json")
    notes = _load("notes.json")
    table_formats = _load("table_formats.json")
    if not isinstance(blocks, list): blocks = []
    if not isinstance(spans, list): spans = []
    if not isinstance(styles, list): styles = []
    if not isinstance(notes, list): notes = []
    if not isinstance(table_formats, list): table_formats = []

    # Clone active blocks and remap ids, compacting ordinals
    src_blocks = [b for b in blocks if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("document_id") == src_doc.get("id") and b.get("status") == "active"]
    src_blocks.sort(key=lambda x: (x.get("ordinal", 0), str(x.get("id", ""))))
    ordinal_map = {}
    block_id_map = {}
    new_blocks = []
    for i, b in enumerate(src_blocks):
        new_id = _gen_id("owd_blk")
        block_id_map[b.get("id")] = new_id
        ordinal_map[b.get("id")] = i
        nb = dict(b)
        nb["id"] = new_id
        nb["document_id"] = None  # set later once dest doc id created
        nb["ordinal"] = i
        nb["created_at"] = now
        nb["updated_at"] = now
        new_blocks.append(nb)

    # Create dest document row
    new_doc_id = _gen_id("owd_doc")
    new_doc = dict(src_doc)
    new_doc["id"] = new_doc_id
    new_doc["directory"] = dest_dir
    new_doc["filename"] = dest_fn
    new_doc["full_path"] = dest_full
    new_doc["status"] = "active"
    new_doc["content_version"] = 1
    # reset protection fields
    new_doc["protected_password_hash"] = None
    new_doc["protection_algorithm"] = None
    # cache is a derived artifact; copying may copy or reset; here reset to force recompute
    new_doc["cached_full_text"] = None
    new_doc["cached_outline"] = None
    new_doc["last_indexed_at"] = None
    new_doc["created_at"] = now
    new_doc["updated_at"] = now

    # enforce uniqueness on full_path
    for d in docs:
        if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("full_path") == dest_full:
            _log("error", "CONFLICT")
            return _err("CONFLICT", "destination document already exists", destination_filename=destination_filename or dest_full)

    # Set document_id on new blocks
    for nb in new_blocks:
        nb["document_id"] = new_doc_id

    # Clone active styles (upsert uniqueness isn't needed since new doc has no rows)
    src_styles = [s for s in styles if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("document_id") == src_doc.get("id") and s.get("status") == "active"]
    new_styles = []
    for s in src_styles:
        ns = dict(s)
        ns["id"] = _gen_id("owd_sty")
        ns["document_id"] = new_doc_id
        ns["created_at"] = now
        ns["updated_at"] = now
        new_styles.append(ns)

    # Clone active notes, only those whose block_id maps (paragraph/heading notes)
    src_notes = [n for n in notes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("document_id") == src_doc.get("id") and n.get("status") == "active"]
    new_notes = []
    for n in src_notes:
        old_bid = n.get("block_id")
        if old_bid not in block_id_map:
            continue
        nn = dict(n)
        nn["id"] = _gen_id("owd_not")
        nn["document_id"] = new_doc_id
        nn["block_id"] = block_id_map[old_bid]
        nn["created_at"] = now
        nn["updated_at"] = now
        new_notes.append(nn)

    # Clone active text spans, only those whose block_id maps
    src_spans = [sp for sp in spans if isinstance(sp, dict) and sp.get("document_id") == src_doc.get("id") and sp.get("status") == "active"]
    new_spans = []
    for sp in src_spans:
        old_bid = sp.get("block_id")
        if old_bid not in block_id_map:
            continue
        nsp = dict(sp)
        nsp["id"] = _gen_id("owd_spn")
        nsp["document_id"] = new_doc_id
        nsp["block_id"] = block_id_map[old_bid]
        nsp["created_at"] = now
        nsp["updated_at"] = now
        new_spans.append(nsp)

    # Clone active table formats, only those whose table_block_id maps
    src_tfs = [tf for tf in table_formats if isinstance(tf, dict) and tf.get("document_id") == src_doc.get("id") and tf.get("status") == "active"]
    new_tfs = []
    for tf in src_tfs:
        old_tb = tf.get("table_block_id")
        if old_tb not in block_id_map:
            continue
        ntf = dict(tf)
        ntf["id"] = _gen_id("owd_tbf")
        ntf["document_id"] = new_doc_id
        ntf["table_block_id"] = block_id_map[old_tb]
        ntf["created_at"] = now
        ntf["updated_at"] = now
        new_tfs.append(ntf)

    # Persist
    docs.append(new_doc)
    blocks.extend(new_blocks)
    styles.extend(new_styles)
    notes.extend(new_notes)
    spans.extend(new_spans)
    table_formats.extend(new_tfs)

    _save("documents.json", docs)
    _save("document_blocks.json", blocks)
    _save("styles.json", styles)
    _save("notes.json", notes)
    _save("text_spans.json", spans)
    _save("table_formats.json", table_formats)

    _log("ok", None, {"source": src_doc.get("full_path"), "destination": dest_full})
    return {"document": new_doc, "destination_filename": dest_full}

tool_schemas.name: get_document_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns stored information for a document, including its metadata and protection state for the given filename. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the document.

tool_schemas.name: get_document_text
tool_schemas.description: Extracts and returns the document’s plain text content by reading the persisted structure for the given filename. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the document. Raises CONFLICT if the document is in a protected state that disallows text extraction.

tool_schemas.name: get_document_outline
tool_schemas.description: Returns the document’s structural outline (e.g., headings/sections and block order) as derived from the persisted representation for the given filename. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the document.

tool_schemas.name: list_available_documents
tool_schemas.description: Lists available .docx documents under the specified directory and returns the full collection as a single, non-paginated result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if directory is empty/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to enumerate documents in that location. Raises NOT_FOUND if the directory does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: add_paragraph
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new paragraph block with the provided text to the end of the document and returns the updated document outline (including the newly added block). Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if text is empty/invalid or style is not a string when provided, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to edit the document. Raises CONFLICT if the document is protected or otherwise not in an editable state.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def add_paragraph(filename, text, style=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0409000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0409000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    start = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    status_code = "OK"

    def _record(endpoint, cred, status, extra=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
        latency_ms = int((now - start).total_seconds() * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_id": cred,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "timestamp": now.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z",
        }
        if extra:
            row.update(extra)
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    def _norm_full_path(p):
        if not isinstance(p, str):
            return None
        p = p.strip()
        if not p:
            return None
        if not p.lower().endswith(".docx"):
            p = p + ".docx"
        p = p.replace("\\", "/")
        while "//" in p:
            p = p.replace("//", "/")
        return p

    def _new_id(prefix, existing_ids):
        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
        base = f"{prefix}_{now}"
        if base not in existing_ids:
            return base
        i = 2
        while f"{base}_{i}" in existing_ids:
            i += 1
        return f"{base}_{i}"

    full_path = _norm_full_path(filename)
    if full_path is None:
        status_code = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"reason": "invalid_filename"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "filename is required and must be a non-empty string")

    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        status_code = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"reason": "invalid_text"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "text is required and must be a non-empty string")

    if style is not None and not isinstance(style, str):
        status_code = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"reason": "invalid_style"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "style must be a string or null")

    docs = _load("documents.json")
    doc = None
    for d in docs:
        if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("full_path") == full_path:
            doc = d
            break
    if not doc or doc.get("status") == "deleted":
        status_code = "NOT_FOUND"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "document not found")

    if doc.get("status") == "protected":
        status_code = "CONFLICT"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"reason": "document_protected"})
        return _err("CONFLICT", "document is protected")

    if doc.get("status") not in ("active", "archived"):
        status_code = "INVALID_TRANSITION"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"reason": "invalid_document_status"})
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "cannot modify document in its current status")

    blocks = _load("document_blocks.json")
    if not isinstance(blocks, list):
        blocks = []

    active_blocks = [b for b in blocks if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("document_id") == doc.get("id") and b.get("status") == "active"]
    max_ord = -1
    for b in active_blocks:
        o = b.get("ordinal")
        if isinstance(o, int) and o > max_ord:
            max_ord = o
    new_ordinal = max_ord + 1

    existing_ids = {b.get("id") for b in blocks if isinstance(b, dict) and isinstance(b.get("id"), str)}
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    new_block = {
        "id": _new_id("blk", existing_ids),
        "document_id": doc.get("id"),
        "block_type": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": new_ordinal,
        "status": "active",
        "text": text,
        "paragraph_style": style,
        "heading_level": None,
        "table_rows": None,
        "table_cols": None,
        "table_data": None,
        "image_path": None,
        "image_width_in": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    # Enforce unique(document_id, ordinal) where active
    if any(isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("document_id") == doc.get("id") and b.get("status") == "active" and b.get("ordinal") == new_ordinal for b in blocks):
        status_code = "CONFLICT"
        _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"reason": "ordinal_conflict"})
        return _err("CONFLICT", "could not allocate new block ordinal")

    blocks.append(new_block)
    _save("document_blocks.json", blocks)

    # Increment content_version and update timestamps; clear stale caches
    cv = doc.get("content_version")
    if not isinstance(cv, int) or cv < 1:
        cv = 1
    doc["content_version"] = cv + 1
    doc["updated_at"] = now
    doc["last_indexed_at"] = None
    doc["cached_full_text"] = None
    doc["cached_outline"] = None
    _save("documents.json", docs)

    # Return updated outline via same derivation logic
    # (do not call tool function to avoid double logging)
    active_blocks = [b for b in blocks if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("document_id") == doc.get("id") and b.get("status") == "active"]
    active_blocks.sort(key=lambda b: (b.get("ordinal") if isinstance(b.get("ordinal"), int) else 10**18, b.get("id") or ""))
    heading_blocks = [
        b for b in active_blocks
        if b.get("block_type") == "heading"
        and isinstance(b.get("heading_level"), int)
        and 1 <= b.get("heading_level") <= 9
    ]
    root = {"type": "root", "children": []}
    stack = [(0, root)]
    for hb in heading_blocks:
        lvl = hb.get("heading_level")
        node = {
            "type": "heading",
            "block_id": hb.get("id"),
            "ordinal": hb.get("ordinal"),
            "level": lvl,
            "text": hb.get("text"),
            "children": []
        }
        while stack and stack[-1][0] >= lvl:
            stack.pop()
        parent = stack[-1][1] if stack else root
        parent["children"].append(node)
        stack.append((lvl, node))

    block_order = [{
        "block_id": b.get("id"),
        "ordinal": b.get("ordinal"),
        "block_type": b.get("block_type"),
        "heading_level": b.get("heading_level"),
        "text_preview": (b.get("text")[:200] if isinstance(b.get("text"), str) else None),
    } for b in active_blocks]

    outline = {
        "document": {
            "id": doc.get("id"),
            "full_path": doc.get("full_path"),
            "directory": doc.get("directory"),
            "filename": doc.get("filename"),
            "title": doc.get("title"),
            "author": doc.get("author"),
            "status": doc.get("status"),
            "content_version": doc.get("content_version"),
            "updated_at": doc.get("updated_at"),
        },
        "headings_tree": root["children"],
        "block_order": block_order,
        "generated_at": now,
    }

    status_code = "OK"
    _record("add_paragraph", None, status_code, {"document_id": doc.get("id"), "new_block_id": new_block["id"]})
    return {"outline": outline}

tool_schemas.name: add_heading
tool_schemas.description: Appends a heading block with the provided text and heading level to the end of the document and returns the updated document outline. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if level is not an integer in the range 1–9 or text is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to edit the document. Raises CONFLICT if the document is protected or otherwise not in an editable state.

tool_schemas.name: add_picture
tool_schemas.description: Appends an image block to the end of the document using the referenced image_path and optional width (in inches), returning the updated document outline. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist or the image_path cannot be resolved, VALIDATION_ERROR if width is non-positive or not a number when provided, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to edit the document or access the referenced media. Raises CONFLICT if the document is protected or otherwise not in an editable state.

tool_schemas.name: add_table
tool_schemas.description: Appends a table block with the specified row/column dimensions and optional cell data, returning the updated document outline. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if rows/cols are not positive integers or if data is provided but is not a 2D array of strings matching the table shape, and NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to edit the document and CONFLICT if the document is protected or otherwise not in an editable state.

tool_schemas.name: add_page_break
tool_schemas.description: Inserts a page break at the end of the specified document and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the document path does not exist or is not registered, and FORBIDDEN if the document is currently password-protected/locked for editing or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: delete_paragraph
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the paragraph at paragraph_index (0-based) from the specified document and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paragraph_index is negative or not an integer, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, and NOT_FOUND if paragraph_index does not refer to an existing paragraph in the document.

tool_schemas.name: search_and_replace
tool_schemas.description: Finds all occurrences of find_text in the specified document and replaces them with replace_text, returning the updated document representation (and replacement outcome). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if find_text is empty, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the document is password-protected/locked for editing or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: create_custom_style
tool_schemas.description: Creates a custom named style in the specified document (optionally based on base_style and with the provided font/format properties) and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if style_name is empty or if provided style attributes are of the wrong type, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, and CONFLICT if a style with the same name already exists in the document or base_style is specified but does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: format_text
tool_schemas.description: Applies character formatting (bold/italic/underline/color/font_size/font_name) to the text range [start_pos, end_pos) within the given paragraph and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if start_pos/end_pos are negative, start_pos is greater than end_pos, or positions are out of bounds for the paragraph text, NOT_FOUND if the document or paragraph_index does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the document is password-protected/locked for editing or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: format_table
tool_schemas.description: Updates formatting for the table at table_index (0-based), including optional header-row treatment, border style, and per-cell shading matrix, and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if table_index is negative, border_style is not supported, or shading dimensions/types are invalid for the table, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist or table_index does not refer to an existing table, and FORBIDDEN if the document is password-protected/locked for editing or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: protect_document
tool_schemas.description: Enables password protection on the specified document using the provided password and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if password is empty, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, and CONFLICT if the document is already protected.

tool_schemas.name: unprotect_document
tool_schemas.description: Removes password protection from the specified document (when the provided password matches) and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if password is empty, NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the password is incorrect, and CONFLICT if the document is not currently protected.

tool_schemas.name: add_footnote_to_document
tool_schemas.description: Adds a footnote with footnote_text to the paragraph at paragraph_index (0-based) and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if footnote_text is empty or paragraph_index is negative, NOT_FOUND if the document or paragraph_index does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the document is password-protected/locked for editing or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: add_endnote_to_document
tool_schemas.description: Adds an endnote with endnote_text to the paragraph at paragraph_index (0-based) and returns the updated document representation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if endnote_text is empty or paragraph_index is negative, NOT_FOUND if the document or paragraph_index does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the document is password-protected/locked for editing or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: convert_footnotes_to_endnotes_in_document
tool_schemas.description: Converts every footnote in the specified document into an endnote and returns the updated document representation for that file. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document path does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if the file is not a supported Word document or cannot be parsed, and FORBIDDEN if the document is protected/read-only or you are not authorized to modify it.

tool_schemas.name: customize_footnote_style
tool_schemas.description: Updates the document’s footnote numbering settings (numbering_format and start_number) and, when provided, the footnote reference font name and/or font size, returning the updated document representation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document path does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if numbering_format is unsupported, start_number is invalid (e.g., non-positive), or font_size is out of range, and FORBIDDEN if the document is protected/read-only or you are not authorized to edit styles.

tool_schemas.name: get_paragraph_text_from_document
tool_schemas.description: Returns the plain text content of the paragraph at paragraph_index (0-based) in the specified document. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document path does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if paragraph_index is negative or outside the document’s paragraph range, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the document.

tool_schemas.name: find_text_in_document
tool_schemas.description: Searches the document for text_to_find and returns all matches with their locations within the document structure; matching behavior is controlled by match_case and whole_word. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document path does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if text_to_find is empty/invalid or the document cannot be parsed, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the document.

tool_schemas.name: convert_to_pdf
tool_schemas.description: Exports the specified Word document to a PDF and returns the output PDF location (output_filename if provided, otherwise the source filename with a .pdf extension). Raises NOT_FOUND if the source document path does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if the document cannot be parsed or output_filename is invalid, CONFLICT if output_filename already exists and cannot be overwritten, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to export the document or the document’s protection state disallows export.

tool_schemas.name: update_document_info
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable document metadata and/or status for the given filename, returning the updated document record. Allows driving supported lifecycle transitions (active↔protected via dedicated tools; active/protected→archived, archived→active, and any non-deleted→deleted) by setting status. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to update the document, and CONFLICT if an invalid transition is requested or the document is protected and the update is not permitted.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Target document filename (normalized to a .docx full_path).

status.title: Status
status.description: Requested status transition (null leaves unchanged). Use protect_document/unprotect_document for protected transitions.

tool_schemas.name: archive_document
tool_schemas.description: Archives a document by transitioning its status to archived, returning the updated document metadata. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized, VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is invalid, and CONFLICT if the document is deleted or the transition is not allowed (e.g., already archived or blocked by protection rules).

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Target document filename (normalized to a .docx full_path).

tool_schemas.name: restore_archived_document
tool_schemas.description: Restores an archived document back to active status, returning the updated document metadata. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized, VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is invalid, and CONFLICT if the document is deleted or not currently archived.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Target document filename (normalized to a .docx full_path).

tool_schemas.name: delete_document
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a document by transitioning its status to deleted, returning the updated document metadata. Deleted documents are excluded from listing and cannot be read/edited by other tools. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized, VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is invalid, and CONFLICT if the document is already deleted or the transition is not allowed.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Target document filename (normalized to a .docx full_path).

tool_schemas.name: get_document_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted content blocks for a document in ordinal order, optionally filtered by type and/or status, returning a paginated result set. Raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the document, and CONFLICT if the document is deleted or protected in a way that disallows block inspection.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Target document filename (normalized to a .docx full_path).

block_type.title: Block Type
block_type.description: Filter returned blocks to a single type (null returns all types).

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Maximum number of blocks per page.

metadata.name: Office Word Document Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Word documents managed by an API, including their file locations, metadata, protection state, and a persisted representation of document structure (paragraphs/tables/media) to support read and edit operations.
